scope: Spellcheck/grammar expansion toward Microsoft Editor: larger dictionaries, Vietnamese typos, punctuation/grammar rules, alternative suggestions, real-doc QA

implementation.dictionaryEnglish: 227 typo→correction entries (was ~150); removed the self-map coordinate→coordinate
implementation.dictionaryVietnamese: 27 explicit Vietnamese entries: malformed diacritics (khống, ngừoi, đựơc, thựât…) plus common no-diacritic words (khong, duoc, nguoi, viec, nghiep, cong)
implementation.alternatives: SpellIssue.alternatives carries extra corrections (e.g. khong → không + khổng, adress → address/addresses/addressing); UI shows them as one-click buttons and applySpellSuggestion writes the chosen replacement
grammar: missing space between punctuation and capital word (existing)
space after opening bracket / before closing bracket
missing space after ; : and after , before a letter
sentence-start lowercase with abbreviation guard (v., TP., etc.)

runtimeQA.sample: spell-sample.docx: 'khong duoc viec  nay ,va recieve goverment'
runtimeQA.before: khong duoc viec nay ,va recieve goverment
runtimeQA.after: không duoc viec nay ,va recieve goverment

realDocument.note: No deliberate misspellings remain in the real proposal; the expanded dictionary adds no false positives

remaining: Rule/dictionary based checker, not a cloud language model like Microsoft Editor; no full Vietnamese lexicon
Real-doc grammar detection is conservative (3 grammar issues) to avoid false positives
Ink is rendered as an SVG overlay, not native ink
VBA macros cannot run in the browser (same as Word for the web)
